asked.item: Did my account break? / why only a big box

verdict.reason: The FAQ describes this exact empty Post editor screen and how to reach Calendar and Settings via the navigation menu.

steps.text: The empty Post editor screen shows "What are we making today?" and a Write posts about... box.
You do not need to generate a draft to access the rest of Blotato.
Open the navigation menu, then select Calendar, Posts, Videos, Accounts, or Settings.
